collection.description: A rare reef fish sheds scales that make seawater-proof dyes, and only three such fish are known.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A rare reef fish sheds a scale whose pigment makes dyes unusually resistant to seawater. Only three fish have been observed.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The dye maker gets very little pigment but the fish remain alive.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A valuable sample is obtained, but the population may be harmed and the decision becomes controversial.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A mineral glaze works nearly as well but costs more labor.

d__fx.name: Answer D
d__fx.text: The village restricts disturbance and learns more about breeding.

d__text.name: Answer D
d__text.text: The village restricts disturbance and learns more about breeding.
